whenToUse: An event venue hiring rooms by layout and head count, with viewings and enquiries.
Wedding, conference or party spaces that show capacities on a site plan.
avoidWhen: A single wedding's own site — use site-wedding-01.
Ticketed events or conferences — use site-event-01.
a11y: Matching rooms and the hire estimate are announced through aria-live; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
